SELECT
    ri.churnflag AS churn_risk_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.userregistry) AS fan_count,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - i.timemark)) / 3600) AS avg_time_since_last_activity_hours,
    AVG(e.engrate) AS avg_engagement,
    AVG(ps.intconsist) AS avg_interaction_consistency,
    AVG(
        CASE
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'None' THEN 0
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'High' THEN 3
        END
    ) AS avg_risk_score
FROM
    retentionandinfluence ri
JOIN
    engagement e ON ri.retainengagepivot = e.engagereg
JOIN
    fans f ON e.engagememberpivot = f.userregistry
LEFT JOIN
    interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
LEFT JOIN
    preferencesandsettings ps ON f.userregistry = ps.preferencesmemberpivot
GROUP BY
    ri.churnflag;

SELECT
    ri.churnflag AS churn_risk_level,
    la.reward_progress->>'rewtier' AS reward_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.userregistry) AS fan_count,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - i.timemark)) / 3600 / 24) AS avg_time_since_last_activity,
    AVG(e.engrate) AS avg_engagement,
    AVG(ps.intconsist) AS avg_interaction_consistency,
    AVG(
        CASE
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'High' THEN 5
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'Medium' THEN 3
            WHEN ri.churnflag = 'Low' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS avg_risk_score
FROM
    RetentionAndInfluence ri
JOIN
    LoyaltyAndAchievements la ON ri.retainloyaltypivot = la.loyaltyreg
JOIN
    Engagement e ON ri.retainengagepivot = e.engagereg
JOIN
    Interactions i ON e.engageactivitypivot = i.activityreg
JOIN
    PreferencesAndSettings ps ON i.activityreg = ps.prefreg
JOIN
    Fans f ON i.interactfanpivot = f.userregistry
GROUP BY
    ri.churnflag, la.reward_progress->>'rewtier'
ORDER BY
    avg_risk_score DESC;

SELECT 
    f.userregistry AS user_id,
    f.nicklabel AS nickname,
    (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'contqualrate')::DECIMAL AS content_quality_score,
    (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'ugcval')::INT AS content_volume,
    (f.personal_attributes->'network'->>'follcount')::INT AS follower_count,
    'Content Creator' AS creator_type
FROM 
    fans AS f
JOIN 
    socialcommunity AS sc ON f.userregistry = sc.socialreg
WHERE 
    (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'ugcval')::INT > 20
    AND (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'contqualrate')::DECIMAL > 7.0
    AND (
        (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'artsubs')::INT > 3
        OR (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'ficsubs')::INT > 2
        OR (sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'coverperfcnt')::INT > 0
    )
ORDER BY 
    content_quality_score DESC, 
    follower_count DESC;

WITH FanData AS (
    SELECT 
        f.userregistry, 
        f.nicklabel AS nickname, 
        f.tierstep AS tier_level, 
        e.socintscore AS engagement_score, 
        m.spendusd AS financial_contribution, 
        f.statustag AS fan_status
    FROM 
        fans f
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON f.userregistry = e.engagememberpivot
    JOIN 
        membershipandspending m ON f.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
    WHERE 
        f.statustag = 'Active'
),
SuperfanLabel AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.*, 
        CASE 
            WHEN fd.engagement_score > (SELECT AVG(socintscore) FROM engagement) 
            AND fd.financial_contribution > (SELECT AVG(spendusd) FROM membershipandspending) 
            THEN 'Superfan' 
            ELSE 'Regular Fan' 
        END AS fan_label
    FROM 
        FanData fd
)
SELECT 
    nickname, 
    tier_level, 
    engagement_score, 
    financial_contribution, 
    fan_label
FROM 
    SuperfanLabel
ORDER BY 
    engagement_score DESC, 
    financial_contribution DESC;

WITH FanIdolCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        i.interactfanpivot AS fan_id, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.interactidolpivot) AS idol_count
    FROM 
        interactions i
    GROUP BY 
        i.interactfanpivot
),
FanIdolDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        f.userregistry AS user_id,
        f.nicklabel AS nickname,
        fic.idol_count,
        STRING_AGG(vi.nametag, ', ') AS idol_names,
        AVG(e.socintscore) AS avg_engagement
    FROM 
        fans f
    JOIN 
        FanIdolCounts fic ON f.userregistry = fic.fan_id
    JOIN 
        interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
    JOIN 
        virtualidols vi ON i.interactidolpivot = vi.entityreg
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON i.activityreg = e.engageactivitypivot
    WHERE 
        fic.idol_count > 1
    GROUP BY 
        f.userregistry, f.nicklabel, fic.idol_count
)
SELECT 
    user_id, 
    nickname, 
    idol_count, 
    idol_names, 
    avg_engagement
FROM 
    FanIdolDetails
ORDER BY 
    idol_count DESC, 
    avg_engagement DESC;

WITH SilentSupporters AS (
    SELECT 
        f.nicklabel,
        f.userregistry,
        (ms.spendusd + cc.merchspendusd + cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd) AS economic_impact,
        e.engrate AS engagement_rate,
        ms.membkind AS membership_tier,
        (ms.spendusd / (i.engagement_metrics->>'watchhrs')::decimal) AS revenue_per_view,
        e.contpref AS content_preference_classification,
        (
            (cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd + cc.merchspendusd) / (
                ms.spendusd + cc.merchspendusd + cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd
            )
        ) AS activity_ratio,
        (i.engagement_metrics->>'chatmsg')::decimal / (i.engagement_metrics->>'liveatt')::decimal AS chat_to_session_ratio,
        mv.monetization_value
    FROM 
        fans f
    JOIN 
        membershipandspending ms ON f.userregistry = ms.memberfanpivot
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON ms.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
    JOIN 
        commerceandcollection cc ON e.engagereg = cc.commerceengagepivot
    JOIN 
        interactions i ON e.engageactivitypivot = i.activityreg
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            ms.memberfanpivot,
            (ms.spendusd + cc.merchspendusd + cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd) / (
                e.engrate + 1
            ) AS monetization_value
        FROM 
            membershipandspending ms
        JOIN 
            engagement e ON ms.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
        JOIN 
            commerceandcollection cc ON e.engagereg = cc.commerceengagepivot
        JOIN 
            interactions i ON e.engageactivitypivot = i.activityreg
    ) mv ON f.userregistry = mv.memberfanpivot
    WHERE 
        mv.monetization_value > 100
        AND e.engrate < 0.3
        AND (i.engagement_metrics->>'chatmsg')::decimal / (i.engagement_metrics->>'liveatt')::decimal < 0.5
)
SELECT 
    nicklabel, 
    economic_impact, 
    engagement_rate, 
    activity_ratio, 
    membership_tier, 
    revenue_per_view, 
    content_preference_classification
FROM 
    SilentSupporters;

WITH fan_engagement_index AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.userregistry, 
        (0.2 * t2.engrate) + (0.3 * t2.socintscore) + (0.2 * t2.actdayswk) + (0.3 * t2.avgsesscount) AS fei_score
    FROM 
        fans AS t1
    JOIN 
        engagement AS t2 ON t1.userregistry = t2.engagememberpivot
),
monetization_value AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.userregistry, 
        (0.6 * t3.spendusd) + (0.4 * t3.membdays) AS mv_score
    FROM 
        fans AS t1
    JOIN 
        membershipandspending AS t3 ON t1.userregistry = t3.memberfanpivot
),
superfan_criteria AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.userregistry, 
        t1.nicklabel, 
        t1.tierstep, 
        t2.fei_score, 
        t3.mv_score, 
        CASE 
            WHEN t1.tierstep >= 8 AND t2.fei_score > 0.7 AND t3.mv_score > 200 THEN 'Superfan' 
            ELSE 'Regular Fan' 
        END AS fan_category
    FROM 
        fans AS t1
    JOIN 
        fan_engagement_index AS t2 ON t1.userregistry = t2.userregistry
    JOIN 
        monetization_value AS t3 ON t1.userregistry = t3.userregistry
    WHERE 
        t1.statustag = 'Active'
)
SELECT 
    nicklabel, 
    tierstep, 
    fei_score AS engagement_score, 
    mv_score AS financial_contribution, 
    fan_category
FROM 
    superfan_criteria
ORDER BY 
    engagement_score DESC, 
    financial_contribution DESC;

WITH fan_engagement_index AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.userregistry, 
        t1.nicklabel, 
        t1.tierstep, 
        t3.engrate, 
        t3.socintscore, 
        t3.actdayswk, 
        t3.avgsesscount, 
        t2.spendusd, 
        t2.membdays, 
        ((t3.engrate + t3.socintscore + t3.actdayswk + t3.avgsesscount) / 4) AS fei, 
        (spendusd * (membdays / 365.0)) AS mv 
    FROM 
        fans AS t1 
    JOIN 
        membershipandspending AS t2 ON t1.userregistry = t2.memberfanpivot 
    JOIN 
        engagement AS t3 ON t2.memberreg = t3.engagememberpivot 
    WHERE 
        t1.statustag = 'Active'
), 
superfans AS (
    SELECT 
        userregistry, 
        nicklabel, 
        tierstep, 
        engrate, 
        socintscore, 
        actdayswk, 
        avgsesscount, 
        spendusd, 
        membdays, 
        fei, 
        mv, 
        CASE 
            WHEN tierstep >= 8 AND fei > 0.7 AND mv > 200 THEN 'Superfan' 
            ELSE 'Regular Fan' 
        END AS fan_category 
    FROM 
        fan_engagement_index 
)
SELECT 
    nicklabel, 
    tierstep, 
    fei AS engagement_score, 
    mv AS financial_contribution, 
    fan_category 
FROM 
    superfans 
ORDER BY 
    engagement_score DESC, 
    financial_contribution DESC;

WITH gift_impact AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.userregistry AS user_id, 
        t1.nicklabel AS nickname, 
        (t2.giftvalusd * t2.gifttot) / 100.0 AS gift_impact_quotient, 
        t3.membkind AS membership_type
    FROM 
        fans AS t1
    JOIN 
        interactions AS t2 ON t1.userregistry = t2.interactfanpivot
    JOIN 
        membershipandspending AS t3 ON t1.userregistry = t3.memberfanpivot
    WHERE 
        t1.tierstep < 50 
) 
SELECT 
    user_id, 
    nickname, 
    gift_impact_quotient, 
    membership_type 
FROM 
    gift_impact 
WHERE 
    gift_impact_quotient > (SELECT AVG(gift_impact_quotient) FROM gift_impact);

WITH total_spend AS (
  SELECT 
    memberfanpivot AS userregistry, 
    SUM(spendusd) AS total_spend 
  FROM 
    membershipandspending 
  GROUP BY 
    userregistry
) 
SELECT 
  t1.userregistry, 
  t2.nicklabel, 
  t1.total_spend 
FROM 
  total_spend AS t1 
  JOIN fans AS t2 ON t1.userregistry = t2.userregistry 
ORDER BY 
  total_spend DESC;
